dimensions.explanation: The 2% longer-run objective is PCE, not CPI. Annual and monthly rates are reported separately.

dimensions.name: labor
dimensions.explanation: Sahm >=0.50 percentage points is a published recession indicator, not an individual job-loss prediction. Claims direction is descriptive.

dimensions.name: growth
dimensions.explanation: GDP is quarterly annualized; industrial/retail changes are separate 3-month rates. Retail sales are nominal, not real GDP.

dimensions.name: monetary_credit
dimensions.explanation: Inversion is a term-spread sign, not a recession declaration. Credit threshold is a product-defined historical percentile.

dimensions.name: market
dimensions.explanation: One equity series avoids redundant index votes; 10% drawdown and 90th percentile are FinPilot descriptive policy assumptions, not validated risk thresholds.
